title: Gallery
subtitle: 本課集中處理 gallery = place / venue where art or objects are displayed 的場所義。 Gallery 可以是一個展覽房、一
description: 本課集中處理 gallery = place / venue where art or objects are displayed 的場所義。 Gallery 可以是一個展覽房、一個獨立藝術空間、一個多功能文化場地，也可以是代表藝術家並出售作品的商業機構。替換時要先判斷 space, venue, institution, scale, and commercial function。

words.example: The old warehouse has been converted into a flexible exhibition space.
words.exampleZh: 這座舊貨倉已改建成靈活的展覽空間。

exercises.original: The gallery occupies two floors of the renovated warehouse.
exercises.zh: 這間畫廊佔據翻新貨倉的兩層。
exercises.upgrade: The exhibition space occupies two floors of the renovated warehouse.

options.explanation: Exhibition space ✓ — a place specifically used to display artworks, objects, or exhibitions。這句的決定性線索是 the physical display space itself is central。因此 Exhibition space 最準確表達這種 gallery。
Art space — a place used for displaying, producing, discussing, or experiencing art。art space 較寬鬆、當代，常包含創作、工作坊或社區活動；若重點只是展覽房間、商業展示或大型展廳，就不夠精準。
Exhibition hall — a large room or building used for exhibitions, fairs, or public displays。exhibition hall 通常更大，適合博覽、大型裝置或正式展覽；小型畫廊語境太大。
Museum — an institution that collects, preserves, researches, and displays objects。museum 是更完整的收藏／保存／研究機構，不等於一個 gallery 或單一展覽空間。
Studio — a place where an artist primarily works or produces art。studio 是創作場所，不是主要展示場所。
Collection — a set of artworks or objects。collection 是作品集合，不是實體空間。

falseSynonyms.zh: 博物館 ≠ gallery museum 通常有收藏、研究、保存與教育功能；gallery 可以更小、更專注展覽或銷售。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A museum is an institution with broader collecting and preservation functions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工作室 ≠ gallery studio 是藝術家創作的地方，不等於展示空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A studio is primarily a place of production.

falseSynonyms.zh: 劇院 ≠ gallery theatre 主要用於表演藝術，不是視覺藝術展示空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A theatre is performance-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在商業展示 sense 接近 showroom 偏產品、設計或銷售展示。
只在多功能機構 sense 接近 art centre 通常包含工作坊、活動、表演等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Art centre is broader and institutional.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在大型展覽空間 sense 接近 通常比 gallery 大、正式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exhibition hall is scale-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收藏 ≠ gallery collection 是作品／物件本身，不是展示場所。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A collection is the set of objects, not the place.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形陷阱 gallery 是場所／機構；gallerist 是畫廊經營者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Check noun meaning and role.
